mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_resume_revision (revision_id, user_id, resume_title, mode, target_json, original_md, status, model, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{userId}, #{resumeTitle}, #{mode}, #{targetJson}, #{originalMd}, #{status}, #{model}, now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT id, revision_id, user_id, resume_title, mode, target_json, original_md, revised_md, changes_json, diff_json, status, model, token_usage, error, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_resume_revision WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId}

SELECT id, revision_id, user_id, resume_title, mode, target_json, original_md, revised_md, changes_json, diff_json, status, model, token_usage, error, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_resume_revision WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_resume_revision SET revised_md = #{revisedMd}, changes_json = #{changesJson}, diff_json = #{diffJson}, model = #{model}, token_usage = #{tokenUsage,jdbcType=INTEGER}, status = 'DONE', error = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId}
UPDATE ai_resume_revision SET status = 'ERROR', error = #{error}, updated_at = now() WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId}
UPDATE ai_resume_revision SET status = 'SAVED', updated_at = now() WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId}
